newsitem.title: UK: Avis Europe sets premium on first day.
newsitem.headline: Avis Europe sets premium on first day.

text.p: Shares in car rental firm Avis Europe Plc set a premium on their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Trading on a "when issued" basis ahead of the formal issue of the shares, they were quoted at 134-1/2p by 1310 GMT, compared with an issue price of 124p.
The firm said earlier on Wednesday its share float had been heavily oversubscribed and that unconditional dealings would start on April 4.
A total of 215 million shares wwere issued, raising an estimated 267 million stg, with a net 161 million going to the company, Avis said in a statement.

"The flotation will enable us to improve our financial strength through access to additional funds and to invest in the further expansion of the business," said Avis Europe chairman and chief executive Alun Cathcart.
